content.text: Hello everyone and welcome to EnglishPod. My name is Marco.

content.text: My name is Katherine and welcome everyone. Today we've got an elementary level lesson for you.
content.trans: 我的名字是凯瑟琳，欢迎大家。今天我们要进行一个初级课程的学习。

content.text: It's all about sending things through the mail.
content.trans: 它只是邮寄东西而已。

content.text: That's right. So maybe gifts, maybe letters. We're going to the post office.
content.trans: 没错。所以也许礼物，也许信件。我们去邮局吧。

content.text: So why don't we jump right into this dialogue? Let's listen to it for the first time and we'll be right back.
content.trans: 所以，我们直接进入这次对话吧？让我们第一次听听它，然后我们会回来的。

content.text: Hi, I would like to send this package to China and these postcards as well.
content.trans: 你好，我想把这个包裹寄到中国，以及这些明信片一起寄。

content.text: Very well. You will need some stamps for the postcards and I need to weigh that package too.
content.trans: 好的。你需要一些邮票来给明信片盖章，我也需要称一下这个包裹的重量。

content.text: Great. How much is this going to cost?
content.trans: 太好了。这得花多少钱？

content.text: Well, it depends. Do you want to send it via priority, express or standard mail?
content.trans: 好吧，这要看你的选择。你想用挂号、特快专递还是普通邮件寄送？

content.text: What's the difference? Well, standard mail can take up to 15 working days.
content.trans: 那有什么区别呢？嗯，标准邮件可能需要长达十五个工作日。

content.text: Priority is a bit faster and we'll arrive in about five to eight working days.
content.trans: 优先级稍快一些，我们大约需要五到八个工作日就能到达。

content.text: Express is the fastest but it's also the most expensive.
content.trans: Express 是最快的，但也是最贵的。

content.text: It only takes three days and you can track your package online.
content.trans: 只需要三天，你就能在网上追踪你的包裹。

content.text: I see. Well, there's no rush. Please send it via priority mail.
content.trans: 我明白了。好吧，不必着急。请通过挂号信件寄送。

content.text: Please be extra careful. The contents of the package are fragile.
content.trans: 请务必小心。包裹里的内容很脆弱。

content.text: All right. So pretty simple dialogue. We want to send a package through the mail.
content.trans: 好的。所以就这么简单的一段对话。我们要通过邮局寄包裹。

content.text: So why don't we take a look at some of those mail-related terms in language takeaway?
content.trans: 所以，我们为什么不看看那些与邮件相关的术语呢？

content.text: Language takeaway.
content.trans:

content.text: All right. So the first item we're going to talk about in today's language takeaway is something you can send.
content.trans: 好的。今天语言小课堂的第一项我们要讨论的是你可以发送的东西。

content.text: It's called a postcard. A postcard. Okay. So very popular among people who are traveling and they want to send a postcard back home.
content.trans: 它叫明信片。明信片。很好玩的，很受喜欢旅游的人们喜爱，他们想要把家乡寄回家乡。

content.text: That's right. So a postcard is something that you usually buy at a tourist destination like Walt Disney World, for example.
content.trans: 没错。所以一张明信片通常是在旅游目的地，比如迪士尼世界这样的地方买的。

content.text: And it has a picture on the front and some words on the back. So you can write a letter on the back of this picture.
content.trans: 而且它在正面有一个图片，背面有一些文字。所以你可以在这张图片的背面写信。

content.text: Uh-huh. So it's very simple. It's not really a letter. You don't put it in an envelope.
content.trans: 嗯。所以这很简单。它不是真的信件。你不会把它放进信封里。

content.text: Mm-hmm. You just write whatever you want on the back of the postcard.
content.trans: 嗯，你随便在明信片背面写什么都可以。

content.text: But you do have to put a stamp on it in order to send it.
content.trans: 但是你还是要在上面盖个章才能寄出去。

content.text: That's right. So stamp is our next word. A stamp comes in different price ranges. That means that
content.trans: 那就是了。所以，邮戳是我们下一个单词。邮戳的价格范围不同，这意味着

content.text: you must place the stamps on the letter on the envelope or on the postcard, right? So depending on the size and weight, it costs more.

content.text: a postcard. You place stamps on it and we need to weigh the package to know how much money we have to pay.
content.trans: 一张明信片。你需要在上面盖章，然后我们需要称重包裹以确定我们应付多少钱。

content.text: That's right. So sometimes a package is very heavy if it's filled with books, for example.
content.trans: 没错。有时候，如果包里装满了书，那么这个包裹可能会非常重。

content.text: Sometimes it's very light if it's filled with clothes or feathers. Mm-hmm.
content.trans: 有时候装满了衣服或羽毛，它会非常轻。嗯哼。

content.text: And so to find out how much something weighs, we have to weigh it. This is a verb.
content.trans: 所以，想知道某物有多重，我们得称它的重量。这是一个动词。

content.text: Okay. So this is a verb, right? Two way. So you want to know how many kilos or how many pounds this item has.
content.trans: 好的。所以这是一个动词，对吧？双向的。你想要知道这个物品有多少公斤或者多少磅吗？

content.text: Right. So we could say it weighs a lot or how much do you weigh?
content.trans: 好吧。那我们可以说它有多重，还是你呢？

content.text: Okay. Things like this. Very good. All right. Moving on, we have the different types of mailing speed, I guess.
content.trans: 好的。像这种。很好。好了。我们有不同类型的邮寄速度，我想。

对吧？所以我们看到了三个人。通过挂号信、快递或是普通邮件的方式寄来的。那么我们分步骤来。首先，我们来看看第一个。

content.text: Via priority mail. Priority is fast. It means priority is something that's important.

content.text: So it depends means there is a situation or a circumstance that might change. And if it does, my answer will change.
